Path: changing a running app without code | studio-authoring.custom-page-render-and-blocks | P1

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `documentation` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in two places ⇒ `domain:ui`, since the docs follow the surface they document:
- `packages/layout/src/ResponsiveGrid.tsx` (the component docblock at `:114`–`:115`, which ships in the package's `.d.ts`);
- `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` (the `grid` row for `columns`).

Rationale: both published texts teach a shape the code no longer has. The docblock attributes the grid's column map to the spec's retired `BreakpointColumnMapSchema`, while the same file declares `@object-ui/layout`'s own `BreakpointColumnMap` (`:53`). The reference row types `GridSchema.columns` as a string-keyed `Record`, where `origin/main` narrows it to a `Partial` `Record` over `BreakpointName` (`packages/types/src/layout.ts:769`, objectui#8505). An AI author who follows the row writes a key the zod mirror refuses. Wrong authoring text is a product defect under North Star rule 4, and the page is its reach. The grade is that of the sibling reference fixes objectui#10662 and objectui#10581 (p3). The filer's category line says ②; this is ① (a defect with named sites).

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T01:38Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments), both sites on objectui `origin/main` `f9c06ef`, and objectui#10662's triage comment `5835256857`.

**Serial constraints.** Draft PR objectui#8941 (the `lucide-react` bump) also edits `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`. That is a different region, so rebase if it lands first. No open PR holds `ResponsiveGrid.tsx`.

**Execution note.** Rewrite the docblock to name the layout package's own `BreakpointColumnMap` (the six keys `xs` to `2xl`, the ones `BreakpointName` spells). This edit is `packages/layout` source, so it takes a `patch` changeset. Retype the row as `number` or a `Partial` `Record` over `BreakpointName`, naming the six keys. Give it a release qualifier only if it must still serve 17.6.0 readers, the way objectui#7599's `rules/protocol.md` paragraph does. The docs row needs no changeset.

Dedupe re-check: every open objectui issue (162), plus the 1000 most recently updated closed issues and PRs, grepped locally for `ResponsiveGrid|BreakpointColumnMapSchema` ⇒ objectui#7599 (open, the skills-catalog half; its PR objectui#10708 does not touch either site) and objectui#3988 (closed, the `gap` prop, a different key). No duplicate.
